chunks: She said: "This is the one you blamed me for. I did desire his person, but he preserved himself from sin. Yet in case he does not do my bidding he will be put into prison and disgraced."
ai.seo_question: What did Zulaikha say about Joseph's resistance and her prediction for his future?
ai.summary: In this verse, Zulaikha details her persistent attempts to seduce Joseph, highlighting his steadfast resistance (ist'lam) and her subsequent threat of imprisonment to enforce her will. This narrative underscores the theme of divine protection for the prophets against worldly temptations and the eventual triumph of chastity over power, a key motif in Shia exegesis regarding the purity of the Prophets (Ismah).
